title: Inbox
description: Every conversation, and what GOTCHA knows about the person on the other end.

stream.unavailable: We couldn't read this conversation just now.
stream.empty: Nothing has been said here yet.
stream.quotedMissing: Replying to an earlier message we don't have.
stream.voiceNoTranscript: A voice note. GOTCHA can't read it out for you — you'll need to listen.
stream.unknownType: Something was sent here that we can't show yet.

system.department_transferred: This was transferred to another team

reaction.toEarlier: They reacted {emoji} to an earlier message

stream.unsupported: They sent something GOTCHA can't show. WhatsApp calls it a “{type}”.
stream.sent: Handed to the channel, not confirmed delivered
stream.failed: This did not send. The customer never received it.
stream.deliveryUnknown: We can’t tell whether this arrived.
stream.mediaUnavailable: This attachment couldn't be fetched — WhatsApp keeps media only a few days.

queue.unavailable: We couldn't read the queue just now.
queue.undated: {count, plural, =1 {One conversation has no last-message time, so we can't place it in the order above} other {# conversations have no last-message time, so we can't place them in the order above}}

queue.label: Waiting

waitingFor.hours: {value, plural, =1 {1 hour waiting} other {# hours waiting}}
waitingFor.days: {value, plural, =1 {1 day waiting} other {# days waiting}}

queue.heading: Waiting in queue

menu.label: Actions on this conversation
menu.greets: Sends your workspace’s greeting to the customer
menu.greetsMaybe: May send your workspace’s greeting to the customer
menu.partial: Done for {done} of {total}. The rest didn’t go through — reload to see where things stand.
menu.failed: That didn’t go through, and nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
menu.confirmTitle: {count, plural, one {Delete this conversation?} other {Delete # conversations?}}
menu.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {It and every message in it are deleted for everyone. This can’t be undone.} other {They and every message in them are deleted for everyone. This can’t be undone.}}
menu.confirmActive: {count, plural, one {It is still open — deleting it ends it now.} other {# of them are still open — deleting them ends them now.}}

identity.unavailable: We couldn't read who this is just now.
identity.noHandles: No channel handle is recorded for this person.
identity.joinedUp: Their channels — every one we've matched to this person.
identity.thisChannelOnly: The channel this conversation came in on. We can't show their other channels from here yet.

verbs.greetingSends: Taking control sends your workspace's greeting to this customer, with your name in it.
verbs.greetingMaybe: If your workspace has a greeting set up, taking control sends it to this customer with your name in it. We can't check that from here.
verbs.noAiEmployee: There's no AI employee on this conversation, so there's nobody to hand it back to. Whoever set up GOTCHA can assign one.

problem.already_claimed: A colleague took this one first, so nothing changed. Ask them before taking it over — the customer would get a second greeting.
problem.no_ai_employee: There's no AI employee on this conversation to hand it back to, so nothing changed.
problem.not_yours: You can only transfer a conversation you're holding. Take control first, and then you can pass it on.
problem.not_found: This conversation, or the person you picked, isn't there any more. Reload to see where things stand.
problem.failed: That didn't go through, and nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
problem.not_allowed: Only an admin can delete conversations, so nothing changed.

open.label: This conversation
open.none: Nothing is open. Pick a conversation from the list to see it here.
open.unavailable: We couldn't read the queue, so there's no conversation to show. This is our side, not yours.
open.waitingUnknown: No last-message time, so we can’t say how long they have waited.

copilot.heading: What GOTCHA would say
copilot.none: GOTCHA has nothing to suggest for this one. Write the reply yourself.
copilot.unavailable: We couldn’t reach GOTCHA for a suggestion just now. Nothing is wrong with the conversation.
copilot.notOnPlan: Suggested replies are not part of your plan, so GOTCHA is not drafting for this conversation.
copilot.limitReached: You have used all the suggested replies your plan includes for now.
copilot.notBuilt: GOTCHA does not offer suggested replies. This is not something a plan change would add.
copilot.whereToChange: Someone with an admin role can change the plan under Settings · Plan & pricing.
copilot.otherMode: This workspace has GOTCHA set up to be asked questions rather than to draft replies, and that panel is not built yet.
copilot.proposal: an action it would take, not a reply
copilot.providerFailed: GOTCHA couldn’t draft a reply just now. Nothing is wrong with the conversation, and this is our side rather than yours.
copilot.noProvider: GOTCHA has no AI provider set up, so it cannot draft replies yet. Someone with an admin role can connect one.
copilot.switchedOff: Suggested replies are switched off for this workspace. Someone with an admin role can turn them on.
copilot.noEmployee: There is no AI employee to draft with. One can be created under Studio · Employees.

composer.label: Your reply
composer.placeholder: Write the reply. Enter makes a new line.
composer.queued: Queued. It will show above as it goes out, and say so if it fails.

error.channelGone: This channel is no longer connected, so nothing can be sent on it. Your reply is still here.
error.gone: This conversation is no longer there.
error.empty: There is nothing to send yet.
error.failed: That didn’t go through. Your reply is still here.
error.tooLarge: That file is over {limit} MB, the most this conversation can take. Nothing was sent.
error.quoteGone: The message you were replying to isn’t in this conversation any more. Your reply is still here.

composer.attached: Will be sent with your reply

compose.label: Rework the draft with GOTCHA
compose.failed: GOTCHA couldn’t rework the draft just now. Your text is unchanged.
compose.blank: GOTCHA came back with nothing, so your text is unchanged.
compose.done: GOTCHA rewrote the draft. Read it before you send — Undo puts yours back.
compose.unitsExhausted: This workspace has used up its AI units, so GOTCHA can’t rework drafts until it’s topped up. Your text is unchanged.

composer.noFileOnReply: A file can’t be sent as a reply to a message
composer.attachedCount: {count} of {max} · sent when you press send

clear.title: The queue is clear
clear.answered: {count, plural, one {GOTCHA answered # conversation today.} other {GOTCHA answered # conversations today.}}
clear.anything: Anything it cannot handle will appear here.
clear.on: {count, plural, one {GOTCHA is on # conversation} other {GOTCHA is on # conversations}}
clear.onNone: GOTCHA is not in a conversation right now
clear.heldNone: Nothing records what is held while a system is down.
clear.waiting: Waiting on the customer to reply
clear.waitingNone: Nothing counts the conversations waiting on a customer.
clear.foot: New conversations land here unless an automation is running them.
clear.allAlone: Every conversation today was answered without a person.
clear.writeNotYet: Starting a conversation from the inbox isn't built yet.

stat.whyNone: Nothing records why a conversation was passed to a person.
